summary_en: Correction to prior MBO disclosure (July 10, 2026). Amendments to transaction agreement: removal of redundant condition (item ⑤ under Nozawa obligation precondition); clarification that Maki's preconditions now include all parties' (Company, Offeror, Katsu Corporation, Nozawa) representations and warranties; stylistic changes to contract termination clause language. Board stance: recommend. Tender period and pricing from original disclosure unaffected.
title_en: Correction Notice on MBO Implementation and Recommendation of Subscription
translation_en_brief: This is a correction notice to an MBO disclosure filed on July 10, 2026. The document clarifies and amends the terms of the transaction agreement (取引基本契約書) between Art Vivant Co., Ltd., the offeror (公開買付者), Maki (牧氏), Katsu Corporation (カツコーポレーション), and Nozawa (野澤氏). Key corrections include: (1) removal of a duplicate condition from the list of Nozawa's obligation preconditions (item ⑤ in the "before" version is eliminated in the "after" version, consolidating two identical requirements into one); (2) clarification that Maki's preconditions now explicitly require that the Company, Offeror, Katsu Corporation, and Nozawa's representations and warranties be true and accurate; and (3) minor language refinements to the contract termination provisions (replacing "本契約の終了" with "契約の終了" and "本取引基本契約" with "本取引基本契約書"). The board of Art Vivant recommends participation in the tender offer. Specific pricing, share count, and timeline remain as disclosed in the original July 10 notice; this correction addresses only legal and contractual clarifications.
